concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-guides-fraud-tools-overview]] - 2026-09-16 umbrella comparison of Basic and Premium fraud-tool tiers, snapshot-scoped availability and fee labels, account enablement and rule routing, and Control Panel lookup of fraud-related `Gateway Rejected` requests; its broad pre-processor wording does not override the dedicated AVS/CVV post-authorization and void flow, and its all-merchants label for Fraud Protection Advanced conflicts with the same-date dedicated product guide's eligible-Braintree-Direct-and-latest-SDK condition, so neither source proves current merchant eligibility or enablement
warnings: The overview's broad pre-processor rejection statement conflicts with the dedicated AVS/CVV guide's post-issuer-approval rejection and void sequence; retain the explicit scope boundary.

The overview labels Fraud Protection Advanced available to all merchants, while the same-date dedicated product guide limits it to eligible Braintree Direct merchants using the latest SDKs; preserve this unresolved conflict and do not infer current or merchant-specific eligibility, provisioning, or enablement.
